name: Optimization Drift Sentinel Registry
purpose: Detect semantic drift introduced by performance optimizations or backend substitutions.

sentinel_checks.description: Verify CPU vs GPU results for identical configurations.
Verify statistical ensemble overlap across implementations.
Verify that critical phase boundaries remain unchanged by optimization.
Verify that backend precision doesn't cause chaotic seed divergence.
Verify that output schemas and units remain consistent across versions.

governance_rules.rule: Drift detection failure triggers an immediate 'CERTIFICATION_REVOKED' status for the affected tool.
